members.name: banking77
members.instructions: A customer of a digital bank (app-based account with physical, virtual and disposable cards, top-ups, transfers and currency exchange) sent this message to support. Which intent best describes what the customer is asking about? Choose exactly one.

criteria.activate_my_card: Activating a newly received card: how to activate it, or activation not working.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum or maximum age to open/use an account; can children or teenagers have an account.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or other phone wallets with the card; adding the card to a phone wallet, or it not working there.
criteria.atm_support: Where to find ATMs, which ATMs accept the card, whether the card can be used at ATMs (not a problem with a specific withdrawal).
criteria.automatic_top_up: Anything about auto top-up: whether it exists, how to set it up or turn it off, how it works, its limits.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: The balance has not updated after a bank transfer, or a transfer they made is not showing up (even when phrased as 'how long does a transfer take? I just made one and it doesn't seem to be working', or 'please check my account to make sure everything went alright, I made the transfer a couple of hours ago'): money transferred in is not showing yet, balance unchanged after a transfer, 'why is it taking so long to update my balance (after a) transfer'.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Deposited a cheque or cash (or just says they 'deposited' money) but the balance has not updated / funds not showing; cheque slow to clear.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a payee/beneficiary, the beneficiary is not allowed / rejected, or trouble transferring money to a beneficiary.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, stop or reverse a transfer or transaction they made (e.g. sent to the wrong account, changed their mind).
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or has expired; how to get a replacement for an expiring card, whether it is renewed automatically, cost of replacement.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted: can it be used in certain shops, online, or for certain merchants; a merchant not accepting the card.
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not arrived yet; tracking a card in the post; card still not delivered.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long a new card takes to arrive, delivery time, express delivery, can they get it by a certain date (asked before a delay).
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the account or app: adding/linking a card that arrived, or an existing card, to the app; card not showing in the app; found a lost card and wants to put it back into the app.
criteria.card_not_working: Something is wrong with the card in general: it is broken, they are unable to use it, it does not work at all or in several different places, 'is my card actually working?'.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Charged a fee or additional fee on a payment/purchase; why was there a fee when paying by card; asks when payments incur extra fees.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment/purchase that they do not recognise or did not make, e.g. 'I didn't make a payment that shows in my app', 'why is this payment on my app' (not a small unexplained extra £1/$1 charge).
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Complaint that the exchange rate or rate charged was wrong/incorrect/bad on a payment or purchase (e.g. 'There's an error with the rate that is charged'). Use this for vague rate complaints unless a cash withdrawal is mentioned.
criteria.card_swallowed: The ATM kept / swallowed / retained the card; card stuck in machine.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Charged a fee for withdrawing cash at an ATM; fees for ATM withdrawals.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account they did not make or do not recognise, e.g. the app shows cash taken out that they did not take, 'some cash is showing up on my app'.
criteria.change_pin: How to change or reset the card PIN.
criteria.compromised_card: Card details may be compromised or used by someone else (fraud, skimming) while the card is still in their possession.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service is available in or supported, can they open/use an account if living in a certain country; also general 'can I get support (here)?' questions and 'in which countries can I get a card?'.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A specific card payment was declined / rejected / refused at a shop or online, e.g. 'I could not get my card to work at a shop', 'my card was declined'.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM refused / declined a cash withdrawal; could not get cash out.
criteria.declined_transfer: The customer says their transfer(s) were declined/rejected/not allowed by the bank, or they were told the transfer is not possible. Use this whenever the customer calls the failed action a transfer being declined (e.g. 'Why do you keep declining my transfers?'), even if a purchase is also mentioned; a card purchase declined without the word transfer is declined_card_payment.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit on the account they do not recognise or did not set up.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits/restrictions of disposable virtual cards: how many uses, how many can be created, spending limits.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details: name, address, email, phone number, other account information.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees/charges for currency exchange; is there a cost or extra fee for exchanging currency or for paying in foreign currency.
criteria.exchange_rate: Informational questions about exchange rates: what rate is used, current rates, how rates are determined (not complaints that a rate was wrong).
criteria.exchange_via_app: Exchanging/converting currencies: how to exchange in the app, which currencies are available for exchange (e.g. 'What currencies are available for exchange?').
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained small extra charge or amount on the statement (e.g. an extra £1, $1 or 'a charge of 1L I do not recognize', 'charged a dollar that is showing as pending'), 'why was I charged' without saying for what kind of transaction.
criteria.failed_transfer: An outgoing transfer failed / did not go through / was returned, or they cannot make a transfer ('Why can I not make a transfer?').
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies the account supports for holding money, paying, or receiving; can I have/use money in currency X. Any question that asks which 'fiat' currencies are supported (for holding and/or exchange) belongs here.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get or create a disposable (single-use) virtual card; what disposable cards are.
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting a physical card when they have a virtual one or after signing up; also where to find the PIN for a new card.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional/extra/spare card, a card for a family member, how many cards can they have.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get or order a virtual card; cost of virtual cards.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card lost or stolen; reporting or blocking a lost/stolen card; asking for help retrieving their card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost, stolen or left behind; how to access the account or block the app without their phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a new physical card, where it can be delivered, countries it ships to, card design.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot app passcode/password, reset or recover app login code.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment/purchase is still pending or has not gone through yet; what pending payments mean; how long until it completes (not an unexplained small $1/£1 charge, which is extra_charge_on_statement).
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal shows as pending or in progress; did not receive their money and the transaction is still in progress.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is still pending / not completed yet.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer or transaction is still pending (e.g. 'waiting forever for this international transfer, why is it taking so long?'); how long it stays pending; 'when will the transaction post to my account?', 'pending transaction to post as cleared', 'I have an outgoing transaction'. A card payment or purchase shown as pending is pending_card_payment.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked or account/card locked after too many wrong PIN attempts; unblock PIN.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money/payments into the account ('Can I use a transfer to receive my transfer?'), getting salary paid in ('Do I need to add my salary?') (including in a given currency), sharing account details to get paid.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund was already agreed or requested but has not appeared in the account; still waiting for a refund; the seller still hasn't returned the money.
criteria.request_refund: Wants to request or get a refund for a purchase; how to get money back from a merchant.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was cancelled, reverted or returned, e.g. 'seems like my card payment has been cancelled', or money was deducted, then came back to the account, and the payment did not go through.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which card brands/types (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, credit cards) and currencies are supported for top-ups or payments, including a card brand not working for adding money.
criteria.terminate_account: Close, delete or cancel the account.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fee/charge for topping up via bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee/charge for topping up with a debit or credit card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque; depositing cash or cheque, where to do it.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed, was declined, did not work, or they are unsure whether their top-up went through (note typos like 'pop-up' for top-up).
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-up amounts: maximum/minimum top-up, how much can be topped up (auto top-up questions go to automatic_top_up).
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up (adding money to the account) was reverted/cancelled/reversed after appearing to go through. Only when a top-up is mentioned; e.g. 'I topped up, saw the money, now it is gone'. If they say they used their card to top up and the money disappeared, use topping_up_by_card.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up with a card; problems topping up by card where the money disappeared or the card was charged but the top-up is missing.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same payment was charged twice / duplicate transaction.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Charged a fee for a transfer; the customer calls it a transfer or says they thought transfers were free (even if the transaction was a purchase).
criteria.transfer_into_account: How bank transfers into the account work ('explain how bank transfers work'), how to transfer money into their own account from another account or bank, can they top up by bank transfer.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Sent a transfer to someone (friend, landlord, retailer, another account) but it has not reached them / not gone through or been posted after some time, though the details were confirmed.
criteria.transfer_timing: Questions about how long transfers take to arrive, transfer speed, processing times, including 'I'm waiting for a transfer from the US, how much longer?', when nothing is said to be wrong or pending.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: They tried to verify their identity and it failed, was rejected, or the system will not accept their documents; the app is not recognising them (identity check trouble, not a forgotten passcode).
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity or complete the identity checks, what documents are needed, how verification works, how long it takes (including 'not sure how to complete the identity checks').
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying or proving the source of funds/money; where to show source of funds.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or a card used for top-up, verification code for a top-up, why top-ups need verification.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: The virtual card does not work / is not accepted.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; choosing between them.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why they need to verify identity, whether verification is required, can they use the account without verifying, why so much personal info is required.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM dispensed a different amount than requested/charged; got less cash than shown.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal abroad or when getting cash; ATM exchange rate complaints; any rate complaint that mentions cash.

Only when a top-up is mentioned; e.g. 'I topped up, saw the money, now it is gone'. If they say they used their card to top up and the money disappeared, use topping_up_by_card.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or a card used for top-up, verification code for a top-up, why top-ups need verification.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: The balance has not updated after a bank transfer, or a transfer they made is not showing up (even when phrased as 'how long does a transfer take? I just made one and it doesn't seem to be working', or 'please check my account to make sure everything went alright, I made the transfer a couple of hours ago'): money transferred in is not showing yet, balance unchanged after a transfer, 'why is it taking so long to update my balance (after a) transfer'.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, stop or reverse a transfer or transaction they made (e.g. sent to the wrong account, changed their mind).
criteria.declined_transfer: The customer says their transfer(s) were declined/rejected/not allowed by the bank, or they were told the transfer is not possible. Use this whenever the customer calls the failed action a transfer being declined (e.g. 'Why do you keep declining my transfers?'), even if a purchase is also mentioned; a card purchase declined without the word transfer is declined_card_payment.
criteria.failed_transfer: An outgoing transfer failed / did not go through / was returned, or they cannot make a transfer ('Why can I not make a transfer?').
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer or transaction is still pending (e.g. 'waiting forever for this international transfer, why is it taking so long?'); how long it stays pending; 'when will the transaction post to my account?', 'pending transaction to post as cleared', 'I have an outgoing transaction'. A card payment or purchase shown as pending is pending_card_payment.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Charged a fee for a transfer; the customer calls it a transfer or says they thought transfers were free (even if the transaction was a purchase).
criteria.transfer_into_account: How bank transfers into the account work ('explain how bank transfers work'), how to transfer money into their own account from another account or bank, can they top up by bank transfer.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Sent a transfer to someone (friend, landlord, retailer, another account) but it has not reached them / not gone through or been posted after some time, though the details were confirmed.
criteria.transfer_timing: Questions about how long transfers take to arrive, transfer speed, processing times, including 'I'm waiting for a transfer from the US, how much longer?', when nothing is said to be wrong or pending.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees/charges for currency exchange; is there a cost or extra fee for exchanging currency or for paying in foreign currency.
criteria.exchange_rate: Informational questions about exchange rates: what rate is used, current rates, how rates are determined (not complaints that a rate was wrong).
criteria.exchange_via_app: Exchanging/converting currencies: how to exchange in the app, which currencies are available for exchange (e.g. 'What currencies are available for exchange?').
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal abroad or when getting cash; ATM exchange rate complaints; any rate complaint that mentions cash.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: They tried to verify their identity and it failed, was rejected, or the system will not accept their documents; the app is not recognising them (identity check trouble, not a forgotten passcode).
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity or complete the identity checks, what documents are needed, how verification works, how long it takes (including 'not sure how to complete the identity checks').
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying or proving the source of funds/money; where to show source of funds.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why they need to verify identity, whether verification is required, can they use the account without verifying, why so much personal info is required.
criteria.change_pin: How to change or reset the card PIN.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked or account/card locked after too many wrong PIN attempts; unblock PIN.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal shows as pending or in progress; did not receive their money and the transaction is still in progress.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Charged a fee for withdrawing cash at an ATM; fees for ATM withdrawals.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained small extra charge or amount on the statement (e.g. an extra £1, $1 or 'a charge of 1L I do not recognize', 'charged a dollar that is showing as pending'), 'why was I charged' without saying for what kind of transaction.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same payment was charged twice / duplicate transaction.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Deposited a cheque or cash (or just says they 'deposited' money) but the balance has not updated / funds not showing; cheque slow to clear.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account they did not make or do not recognise, e.g. the app shows cash taken out that they did not take, 'some cash is showing up on my app'.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM refused / declined a cash withdrawal; could not get cash out.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM dispensed a different amount than requested/charged; got less cash than shown.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund was already agreed or requested but has not appeared in the account; still waiting for a refund; the seller still hasn't returned the money.
criteria.request_refund: Wants to request or get a refund for a purchase; how to get money back from a merchant.
criteria.terminate_account: Close, delete or cancel the account.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum or maximum age to open/use an account; can children or teenagers have an account.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or other phone wallets with the card; adding the card to a phone wallet, or it not working there.
criteria.atm_support: Where to find ATMs, which ATMs accept the card, whether the card can be used at ATMs (not a problem with a specific withdrawal).
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a payee/beneficiary, the beneficiary is not allowed / rejected, or trouble transferring money to a beneficiary.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service is available in or supported, can they open/use an account if living in a certain country; also general 'can I get support (here)?' questions and 'in which countries can I get a card?'.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit on the account they do not recognise or did not set up.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details: name, address, email, phone number, other account information.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies the account supports for holding money, paying, or receiving; can I have/use money in currency X. Any question that asks which 'fiat' currencies are supported (for holding and/or exchange) belongs here.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost, stolen or left behind; how to access the account or block the app without their phone.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot app passcode/password, reset or recover app login code.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money/payments into the account ('Can I use a transfer to receive my transfer?'), getting salary paid in ('Do I need to add my salary?') (including in a given currency), sharing account details to get paid.
